# design.volt.link

design.volt.link is the public Volt design guide for logo usage, colours, typography, layout, accessibility, websites, social media, presentations, files and practical applications.

## Important URLs

- Public guide: https://design.volt.link/
- Sitemap: https://design.volt.link/sitemap.xml
- Robots policy: https://design.volt.link/robots.txt
- Logo preview image: https://design.volt.link/design.volt.link_logo_lila.png

## Languages

The interface supports German, English, Dutch and French. The primary language follows the browser language where possible.

## Scope

The site is a version-1 static guide. It has no login, no backend and no public template library. Internal planning pages are not linked from the public navigation.

## Usage Notes

Use the current public guide for orientation. Archived material is documentation only and not a valid source for new publications. Legal notes in the guide are informational and do not replace formal legal approval.
